decision.summary: The Federal Reserve raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 75 basis points to 3 to 3-1/4 percent.

changes.quote: Recent indicators point to modest growth in spending and production.
changes.explanation: The Committee noted that economic growth in spending and production remains modest.

changes.quote: Job gains have been robust in recent months, and the unemployment rate has remained low.
changes.explanation: The labor market continues to show strong job gains and low unemployment.

changes.quote: Inflation remains elevated, reflecting supply and demand imbalances related to the pandemic, higher food and energy prices, and broader price pressures.
changes.explanation: Inflation remains high due to pandemic-related imbalances, energy costs, and broader pressures.

changes.quote: The Committee is highly attentive to inflation risks.
changes.explanation: The Fed is closely monitoring risks associated with elevated inflation.

changes.quote: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3 to 3-1/4 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.
changes.explanation: The Fed hiked interest rates and signaled that more rate increases will likely be needed.

tone_quotes.quote: Inflation remains elevated, reflecting supply and demand imbalances related to the pandemic, higher food and energy prices, and broader price pressures.
The Committee is highly attentive to inflation risks.

In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3 to 3-1/4 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 15.13% APR, a 75 bp increase raises monthly interest by about $3.13.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.51% and moved -6 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 5.89% would fall by about $11.50 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $45.00 a year more in interest.
Unemployment was 3.6%, and employers added an average of 479k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 8.2% over the past year (August 2022); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 5.4%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 0.6% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +6 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -1.71%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.49% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve intends to keep raising interest rates at upcoming meetings to bring inflation back down to its target. Educational forecast models indicate a 100% probability of another rate hike at the next meeting.
